verses.2:69: قَالُواْ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا لَوۡنُهَاۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةࣱ صَفۡرَآءُ فَاقِعࣱ لَّوۡنُهَا تَسُرُّ ٱلنَّٰظِرِينَ

meaning: The root فقع (fqE) primarily describes intense whiteness or yellowness. It also refers to a type of truffle, often considered inferior, that grows easily visible above ground.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
